nativeCanvasException.actual: Generator-native outputs are 1672x941 for title/background studies, 1448x1086 for splash studies, and 1536x1024 for logo concepts; all are opaque RGB PNGs.
nativeCanvasException.canonicalPolicy: After Human selection, the title uses an approved opaque working master and responsive tuned WebP renditions; the splash uses a straight-alpha contain-first master and justified 512/1024/1536 derivatives; the exact logo is reconstructed locally from separable controlled layers.
nativeCanvasException.exception: Immutable generator originals remain native and are never rescaled or converted in place. Chroma extraction, exact logo reconstruction, registration, responsive crop definition, resize and encoding occur only after source/treatment review.

lineagePolicy.identityReference: approved identity or semantic references only
lineagePolicy.generatedLogoLettering: concept evidence only; never exact wordmark authority

reviewProtocol.decisionRule: Human selects a title direction, a splash direction, and a logo material/construction direction independently.
reviewProtocol.candidateBoundary: Source or concept approval does not switch runtime, add catalogue pointers, approve alpha extraction, approve responsive crops, or retire previous art.

rights.originClaim: Generated for Maze so Puzzle from exact prompts and internal approved references; no named franchise, character, logo, living artist, proprietary palette, UI layout, or composition was requested.

rollback.method: Keep every immutable output and exact prompt. Current title background, live text, runtime assets, catalogue pointers, and preload behavior remain unchanged until explicit selection and a later publication gate.
